issuer: the competent organisational unit of the Ministry of Internal Affairs (Министерство за внатрешни работи) for the area where the citizen lives
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Ministry of Internal Affairs' site. The Law on Road Traffic Safety (Закон за безбедност на сообраќајот на патиштата, "Služben vesnik" 169/15), in the edited consolidated text the Ministry publishes, which takes in every amendment to 193/25: art. 272(2) sets 18 as the minimum age for category "Б"; art. 303 has the application made in person at the Ministry's competent organisational unit for the area where the citizen lives; art. 304 issues the licence for ten years (to five years past 75). A beginner driver (the law's definitions, point 105) is a status of the first two years, not a separate licence. The Ministry's page on the costs of its services gives a driving licence in the regular procedure, first time, at 410 denars for the form and 110 denars administrative tax, 520 denars in all. The identity card is the ids engine's. The Ministry's information on agreements for foreigners' licences is a scanned PDF, not read; no exchange list is held.
